arguments:
set -Eeuo pipefail
temp=$(mktemp -d /tmp/telegram-leads-queue-tests.XXXXXX)
trap 'rm -rf "$temp"' EXIT
git -c credential.helper= clone -q --depth 1 --branch feature/approved-queue-observability-20261031 https://github.com/martaxi-boss/telegram-robot-leads.git "$temp/repo"
cd "$temp/repo"
echo CANDIDATE_SHA=$(git rev-parse HEAD)
git -c credential.helper= fetch -q --depth 8 origin main:refs/remotes/origin/main
GIT_PAGER=cat git --no-pager diff --check origin/main HEAD
echo DIFF_CHECK_PASS
echo CHANGED_FILES_BEGIN
GIT_PAGER=cat git --no-pager diff --name-only origin/main HEAD
echo CHANGED_FILES_END
sudo -n /opt/telegram-robot-leads/.venv/bin/python -B -m unittest discover -s tests -q
echo ALL_UNIT_TESTS_PASS
